title: Arima Nambi
desc: Anamika gets mysteriously abducted while on a date with Arjun. However, when Arjun goes to the police for help, he lands in a dangerous situation.

title: Marumagan
desc: Thangarasu, a humble tailor, falls for Manjula, the daughter of a corrupt politician. Subsequently, her mother opposes their love while her father seeks to exploit their relationship for his own gain.

title: Bramma
desc: Ravivarman, a sketch artist, loses his beloved wife in a tragic flight accident. When he helps the police track a dangerous criminal, the miscreant vows to seek revenge on Ravivarman.

title: Adhibar
desc: Shiva arrives in Chennai from Canada and starts up a real estate business. However, things take a turn when he realises that he is being cheated by the people he trusts.

title: Yennai Arindhaal
desc: Sathyadev, an honest police officer, is on a mission to stop an organ trafficking racket, unaware that the mastermind is the same person who killed his beloved.
